headline: Google turns Gemini into a task-doing agent, free in six countries
dek: The Tasks mode is free in six countries, per Google AI.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The launch
body: Google gave Gemini a "Tasks" mode that completes actions like booking, paying bills and shopping, per Google AI and TechCrunch AI.
It is free in six countries (Google AI).

points.t: App toggle, a text or an email to Gemini.
Connects to more than 60 apps (Google AI).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Why it matters
body: Gemini moves from answering to acting on email, calendar and payments (Google AI).
Card payments start only in the US, with Mastercard and Visa (Google AI).

stat.cap: or more apps already connected (Google AI)

items.t: Computer use reaches the Gemini app (TechCrunch AI).
Needs a Google AI Plus, Pro or Ultra plan.
No date for other countries or languages.

caption.hook: Google turned Gemini into an assistant that completes tasks, and the mode is free.
body: Per Google AI and TechCrunch AI, the new Tasks mode runs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen to book appointments, manage bills and shop, connecting to a user's email, calendar and payment methods. It rolls out free in the US, Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia and India.

Card payments through the Agent Payments Protocol start only in the US, with Mastercard and Visa, and users set a spending cap before approving, per Google AI. TechCrunch AI notes the Mac computer-use feature needs a paid plan and that Google trails OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta.
caption.cta: Would you let an AI pay your bills for you?
